BiblicalUsage: Harhas is named once, as the keeper of the wardrobe and the grandfather of Shallum, the husband of Huldah the prophetess, to whom the priests went when the book of the law was found. His grandson Shallum married the woman who spoke God's word to King Josiah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the single mention is enough to place him: a keeper of robes whose granddaughter-in-law spoke the word of God to a king.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
